title: The Blight: 44 Track Folk Horror Music Pack
tagline: 44 folk horror music tracks for any engine. Twelve village tunes come back darker.
description:
The Blight is a 44 track folk horror music pack for any game engine: a plague village and a witch trial, from May Day to the ashes, in five acts. It ships 38 full looping pieces and 6 short cues (61:14 of music) as OGG with loop tags, plus all 44 MIDI sources. Royalty free for commercial games, and three full tracks are free on this page.

What is inside

44 tracks · 38 loops of a minute or more · 6 cues · OGG + editable MIDI · 61:14

  • Five acts in one village: Before the Blight (12), The Sickness (10), The Accusation (7), The Trial (7) and Ashes (2), plus 6 cues: The Bell Tolls, A Mark on the Door, Witch!, Guilty, Spared and The Blight Spreads.
  • Warm, then wrong: twelve village tunes are heard twice. Before the blight each is in a bright folk mode; after it, the same tune comes back note for note in a darker mode, slower.
  • The passing bell: tubular bells sound in none of the 12 tracks before the blight and in all 32 after it.
  • One seed theme, The May Song, in all 44 tracks, and five more themes for the mill and market, the river, the May dance and the pyre, the sickness and the accusation.
  • Every full piece loops for at least a minute (the shortest loop is 62.3 seconds), with LOOPSTART and LOOPLENGTH tags in its OGG file.
  • 26 General MIDI instruments, among them whistle, recorder, oboe, violin, cello, harp, dulcimer, harpsichord, choir aahs, reed organ and French horn; timpani and tubular bells are the only percussion.

The theory and audio reports (788 and 510 checks, 0 failed) ship inside the download.

The twelve pairs: each warm tune beside its twin, both leads drawn from the shipped MIDI.

The bell in every track after the first death, and the loop length of every full piece.

The score sheet: all 44 tracks, from Thornwick to The Blight Spreads.

Works with

RPG Maker MV and MZ read the loop tags with no plugin. The Readme gives import steps for Godot 4 (followed in a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, all 44 files), Unity and GameMaker. Any engine that plays OGG can use the files, and the MIDI lets you score it with your own sounds.

Try it free

Three full tracks with their MIDI are free on this page: The Village Green, its twin The Green Stands Empty (open both MIDI files and compare the leads), and The Hex, the final boss. More free tracks from our other albums: Overture, the free sampler.

Licence and how it was made

Royalty free for commercial games, no credit required. Do not resell the tracks as music assets. Every track is composed in code and rendered through a General MIDI soundfont (a nylon string guitar plays where a lute would); no generative audio model was used. The code and the cover art were made with AI tools. Every tune was composed for this record; no folk song, game, book or film cue is quoted.

Versions

v1.0 (30 October 2026): first release, 44 tracks.

devlog.title: The Blight is out: a 44 track folk horror score where twelve village tunes come back wrong
devlog.body:
The Blight is a 44 track music pack for games set in a plague village and a witch trial: one village from May Day on the green through the sickness, the accusation and the trial to the ashes, plus six short cues. It is live now, with three full tracks free to download from the page.

The idea. Twelve tunes are heard twice. Before the blight each one is in a bright folk mode; after it, its twin plays the same tune, note for note, on the same key note in a mode two or three steps darker and slower (1,354 lead notes matched in the shipped MIDI, the 491 that change pitch being the ones the darker mode lowers). Tubular bells sound in none of the 12 tracks before the blight and in all 32 after it. The seed theme is stated in its own shape in all 44 tracks, and all 38 full pieces loop for a minute or more (shortest 62.3 seconds).

How it was checked. 788 theory checks and 510 audio checks, 0 failed, with the reports inside the download. The loop tags were followed into a blank Godot 4.7.2 project, all 44 files. Those numbers say the music is correctly written, rendered and tagged. They are not a claim about taste, which is what the free tracks ("The Village Green", "The Green Stands Empty" and "The Hex") are for: the first two are one pair.

The renders are a General MIDI reference render; the MIDI is there so you can move it to your own sounds. No folk song, game, book or film cue is quoted. The composition system is AI written code and no generative audio model is used.

https://csaf.itch.io/the-blight
